Liam (Support): hey team — incoming ticket: ACME noticed their JSON-mode outputs started failing right after we upgraded them to redwood/llama-3-4. Parser error: 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. they say it worked fine 24h ago.

support-bot: Deploy event: redwood/llama-3-4 -> us-east-1 completed 2026-02-20T21:03Z (rolling-upgrade).

Meera K (Infra): can you paste the raw output (not the parsed version) + the exact request params?

Liam (Support): sending curl and raw model output below. customer pasted these into their backend and the JSON.parse throws.

Liam (Support): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-3-4","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a data formatter. Output only valid JSON."},{"role":"user","content":"Return fields: id (int), name (string), items (array of objects with sku, qty). Do not write extra commentary."}],"temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":400,"mode":"json"}'\n```

Liam (Support): raw model output (exact):
```
{"id": 10234, "name": "widget pack", "items": [{"sku": "W-1", "qty": 10}, {"sku": "W-2", "qty": 5}], "metadata": {"source": "catalog"}

Note: prices omitted per user request.
```

Meera K (Infra): I see — the model appended a short sentence after the JSON object which breaks strict parsers. That's consistent with the error. :eyes:

Jorge L (ML): quick hypothesis: the upgraded decoder/penalty changes cause the model to emit a trailing sentence when prompts include high-level instructions like "Do not write extra commentary." At temp>0 there is still low-prob mass for an explanatory suffix. Also the new model version may have slightly different EOS handling.

Jorge L (ML): repro I ran: same prompt + temp=0.0 -> llama-3-3 returns clean JSON. llama-3-4 with temp=0.0 still produced the trailing 'Note:' line in ~8% of runs.

Meera K (Infra): do they use streaming? partial chunking could also leave a truncated final chunk (missing final brace) under certain timeout configs. customer said they stream and pipe into a parser that expects a full object.

Liam (Support): customer environment: node 18, streaming -> assemble then JSON.parse. they pinned no model version, so they auto-upgraded.

Jorge L (ML): mitigation options:
- ask customer to pin to redwood/llama-3-3 until we confirm root cause
- set temperature=0 and disable streaming (assemble full response)
- enable response_schema validation (server-side) so the model is constrained to schema and we do server-side repair or rejection

Meera K (Infra): I'll check if our streaming proxy truncated last bytes on upgrade. Also checking release notes for decoder/tokenizer changes that landed with llama-3-4.

Liam (Support): I've given ACME a quick workaround: pin to redwood/llama-3-3 and set temperature=0, and avoid streaming for now. they're going to test and confirm.

Jorge L (ML): longer term: we should add a pre-parse sanitizer on the API that strips trailing non-json text when response_schema present OR return a structured error with the raw output so clients can fallback. I'll open an RFC.

Meera K (Infra): action items:
- Meera: check streaming proxy logs & config (ETA 2h)
- Jorge: run batch regression across a standard prompt suite comparing 3-3 vs 3-4 for json-mode (ETA EOD)
- Liam: keep ACME updated, confirm if workaround works (ETA 1h)

Liam (Support): noted and assigned. thanks.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0894 (structured-output-regression-after-llama-3-4), severity: P2.

Jorge L (ML): one more datapoint — I saw some cases where the model emits a perfectly valid JSON then repeats it with commentary. If client concatenates chunks naively you can end up with '...}{...Note'. So both trailing commentary and duplicate echoes can break parsers. recommend robust glue code on client.

Meera K (Infra): I'll follow up in INC-2026-0894 once I have logs.

Liam (Support): ACME confirmed workaround (pin + temp=0) fixed their immediate issue. leaving thread open until regression RCA is done. :white_check_mark:
